answer: A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 8 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. The bridge chain is verified at intake and knoll publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 8 epochs old, anchored at a haven checkpoint. Repeating the trick 20 times costs 5 separate deposits and 26 separate proofs of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
